messages:
marie: Follow-up from today's all-hands finance section: here's a concise recap and next steps on runway, procurement thresholds, and fast-track renewals.

tom: Quick q: runway number? heard different figures in breakout.

marie: We're at ~20 months of runway at current net burn after accounting for open offers and Q2 reserved infra. We'll update the dashboard if anything material shifts.

anya: Can you restate the new approval bands? especially for vendor contracts.

marie: New approval bands: manager up to $5k; director approval up to $25k; finance+director for $25k-$75k; exec review above $75k. Multi-year or strategic vendor deals escalate at lower bands. We'll publish a matrix.

sophie: Why the change from >$100k to >$75k for exec review?

marie: More conservative posture given recent multi-year commitments. This helps ensure commercial terms and data controls get exec visibility sooner.

tom: For purchases of GPUs (cloud reserved or on-prem), who marks CapEx vs OpEx?

marie: Finance will label invoices; hardware we own = CapEx, reserved cloud capacity = OpEx. If in doubt, include a note in the procurement form and finance will advise.

procurement-bot: Ticket created: PROC-5010 (fast-track renewal). Requester: tom. SLA: 48h.

anya: What about conference/travel restrictions? Any hard freeze?

marie: No hard freeze. Discretionary spend is limited: conferences require manager approval and a one-line ROI justification. Hiring remains governed by the hiring rubric.

tom: Will the PO tool finally auto-route approvals? manual routing is holding us up.

marie: Pilot of PO workflow starts next week for eng-infra and product. Flow: request -> manager -> procurement -> finance (auto-tag) -> director if over $25k. Attachments stored in procurement drive; links in Confluence.

anya: Action items?

marie: 1) Finance posts approval matrix by EOD Friday. 2) Procurement PO pilot invites out Monday. 3) Use PROC-5010 for urgent renewals and tag @procurement-bot. 4) Finance will add CapEx/OpEx tags on invoices on request.

marie: If teams want a short office hours slot I can host one tomorrow 10:30-11 for clarifying any approvals.

tom: Thanks, that's helpful.

procurement-bot: Procurement doc updated: https://redwood.company/ops/procurement (approval matrix v2).
